summary: M. Yamunacharya was a philosopher and Indologist who studied under Mysore Hiriyanna, Ardeshir Ruttonji Wadia, and Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan. He served as Professor in Philosophy at Maharaja's College, Mysore.

M.L. Pattaratorn Chirapravati is a scholar of Buddhist studies and archaeology. She earned degrees from Silpakorn, Ohio State, and Cornell universities, and served as Associate Professor of Asian Art at California State University, Sacramento (2002–2016).

Maalyada Konduparti works in Indology and religious studies. She held faculty appointments at Andhra University (2015), Alliance University (2016–2017), REVA University (2017–2021), and GITAM University as Associate Professor in 2021.
Maanasa Visweswaran works in Indology and computational fields. She studied at the University of Hamburg and served there as a Wissenschaftliche Projektmitarbeiterin, attested in 2026.

Mabel Haynes Bode was an Indologist and Buddhist studies scholar who earned her Ph.D. at the University of Bern and studied under T. W. Rhys Davids, Cecil Bendall, and Sylvain Lévi. She taught at University College London and SOAS.

Madan Mohan Malaviya studied at Muir Central College, the University of Calcutta, and the University of Allahabad. An Indologist, he founded Banaras Hindu University in 1916 and served as its Vice Chancellor from 1919 to 1938.

Madeleine Biardeau was an Indologist and philosopher who studied at École Normale Supérieure de Sèvres, the University of Kerala, and under K. A. Sivaramakrishna Sastri. She served as Professor of Indian Religions at the École Pratique des Hautes Études (~1956–1989).

Madeleine Giteau studied under Jean Filliozat and André Bareau at the EPHE and completed her Ph.D. at Sorbonne Nouvelle University. She served at the EFEO and as Professor of History and Civilization of South and South-East Asia at Sorbonne Nouvelle.

Madeleine Hallade studied at the École nationale supérieure des beaux-arts and the École du Louvre under Joseph Hackin and Moritz Abraham Stern. She served at the Guimet Museum (1935–1965) and taught at the École du Louvre (~1947–1965).
Madhav M. Deshpande is an Indologist and linguist who studied under Ludo Rocher. He served as a Professor at the University of Michigan, with his appointments attested between 1976 and 2009.

Madhav Sadashiv Gore studied at the Columbia University School of Social Work and at the University of Mumbai under Govind Sadashiv Ghurye (~1956–1960). He later held a post at Jawaharlal Nehru University (~1997–2002).

Madhu Khanna is a scholar in Indology and religious studies who earned a D.Phil. from the University of Oxford. In 2012, she is attested as Director at Jamia Millia Islamia and affiliated with Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts.

Madhu Parameswaran earned an MD in Dravyagunavijnan from Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (2007–2010). He served as Assistant Professor at Vaidyaratnam P.S. Varier Ayurveda College starting in 2011, remaining attested there in 2021.
Madhura Balasubramaniam is a scholar in Tibetology and archaeology. She worked as a Project Associate (2018–2020) and earned her PhD in 2022 from the Indian Institute of Technology Madras.

Madhusudan Amilal Dhaky was a scholar of archaeology and Indology who graduated from Fergusson College. He founded the Archeology Research Group in Porbandar in 1951 and held leadership roles at the American Institute of Indian Studies from 1976 to 2005.
Madhusudan Gupta studied at Sanskrit College and Calcutta Medical College. He taught Ayurveda at Sanskrit College (~1830–1835) and later held a post at Calcutta Medical College (~1835–1856).
Madhusudan Kaul Shastri was an Indologist who served as Superintendent of the Research and Archaeological Department in Jammu and Kashmir, attested during 1918–1934 and 1943–1945.
Madhusudan Rimal is an Indologist who received a PhD from the University of Alberta in 2016 and is attested holding a post there in 2021.
Madhusudan Singh Vats was an Indologist and archaeologist who succeeded Rakhal Das Banerji (Rakhaldas Bandyopadhyay).

Magdalena Szpindler works in Indology, Tibetology, and Buddhist studies. She completed an M.A. at the University of Warsaw (1997–2004) and a doctorate at Adam Mickiewicz University (2016–2022), serving as Adiunkt at the University of Warsaw in 2019.
